summary: Iteration 6 E2E testing of (1) global getmano→getamano rename, (2) new 5-color palette (Scooter teal #2F9D94, Alabaster #F7F6F2, Heather, Blue Lagoon #025F67, Sapphire #063154), and (3) NEW Weekly Market Pulse feature. Backend: 13/13 iteration6 tests PASS (100%) — GET /api/providers/me/market-pulse returns full payload with has_signal=true & available=true for demo provider; 401 without auth; /api/notifications includes exactly 1 weekly_market_pulse note (title='📊 Pulso semanal de Limpieza en Sallisaw', category='market_pulse'); all regression endpoints (categories, providers/featured, public/stats, market-range, promo-codes/founding-status, community/wall-of-fame, admin/ceo-metrics, admin/daily-brief, login flows for both admin and provider) green. Frontend: Landing / renders 'getamano' brand, footer email hola@getamano.com, footer bg rgb(6,49,84)=Sapphire, primary CTAs rgb(47,157,148)=Scooter, body bg rgb(247,246,242)=Alabaster, Blue Lagoon accent rgb(2,95,103) on Buscar button. ZERO stale 'getmano' strings (case-insensitive negative-lookbehind regex) on Landing/Dashboard/Comunidad/Admin pages. Provider login → /dashboard/provider renders MarketPulseCard[data-testid='market-pulse-card'] with full content: 'Pulso Semanal · Limpieza', 'Esta semana en Sallisaw', cotizaciones=1 +100%, precio promedio $115–$190 (2 tarifas activas), top budget $100–$300, tamaño mediano, insight accionable. /comunidad loads Wall of Fame correctly. Admin login → /admin/ceo loads Daily Brief (AI-generated), MRR/ARR metrics, 4 priority action cards. Zero console errors on Landing, 2 transient 401s on admin transition (pre-existing — same as iter-5).

integration_issues.issue: Two 401 errors logged to console during admin login → /admin/ceo redirect (carryover from iter-5: auth-gated endpoints called before session is fully set). Pages render correctly; non-blocking.

action_items: [NONE - iteration objectives met] Optional carryover from iter-5: gate /api/auth/me, /api/favorites, /api/conversations calls behind authenticated flag to silence transient 401s during route transitions.

[OPTIONAL] Milestone celebration modal still surfaces on /dashboard/provider on first visit despite the documented localStorage preload trick (key 'milestone_celebrated_first_msg' was set but a modal still appeared). The MarketPulseCard renders correctly behind it. Consider unifying milestone-suppress key naming or honoring a single 'milestone_celebrated_all=1' flag for testers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 3138 lines — still trending up; should be modularized (auth, providers, messaging, admin, promo, ads, market-pulse).

_compute_market_pulse runs 5 separate aggregations per call (count + budget + size + rates + prior rates). For a dashboard endpoint hit on every page load this is acceptable but consider caching per-(category,city) for 1–6h since the data is weekly-windowed.

Privacy rule sample_size>=3 is implemented as `(this_week_n + rate_n) >= 3` — mixes quote events with rate-row counts, which can mask the intent. Consider requiring rate_sample_size>=3 independently before showing avg_min/avg_max, even if has_signal is true via quote volume.
_build_market_pulse_note hard-codes Spanish strings — fine for now since app is ES-only, but flag for i18n when EN is added.

GET /providers/me/market-pulse returns 404 when no provider profile exists, but returns 200 with {available:false, reason:'no_category'} when profile exists without category. Frontend MarketPulseCard must handle both shapes.
